purpose: Independent expected bytes prepared before actual Mac interaction; no native action or data store created.

scenarios.MAC-01: Type initial, Save; replace with final, Save; navigate and close/reopen; canonical must equal save-final with no recovery session.
scenarios.MAC-03: Backup after final Save; canonical remains save-final.
scenarios.MAC-04: Replace editor with unsaved-recovery, no Save. Read-only check before close must confirm exact durable draft/base/session and unchanged save-final canonical; after OS relaunch verify both again.
scenarios.MAC-10: Fresh saved Note without writing thread: type exact unsent composer text, add first passage comment through normal controls without sending AI, then OS close/reopen. Composer and read-only target draft must preserve exact bytes; canonical Note and unrelated sentinel unchanged.

rules: Use a new explicit synthetic native workspace created by the actual app, not owner data.
Actor uses real controls; checker reads without repairing or mutating authority.
Retain original observed mismatches. Do not change expected fixtures to match output.
Record actual source/artifact identity and read-only note/session IDs at execution.
Preparing fixtures does not establish OS input, rendering, recovery or acceptance.
